commit_message:
Integrate LLVM to llvm/llvm-project@d033127d27ef (#25119)

This LLVM integration goes to just before "910cdcd09377 PassBuilder:
Take LLVMContext for LibraryOptionsContext (#233150)", because this
commit requires bigger work in IREE to how PassBuilder is constructed
and how --print-pipeline-passes is handled.

Due to "45b9b97b83db [mlir][tosa][NFC] Speed up compilation of
TosaProfileCompliance (#233949)" addressing the stacke usage, the
increase of the MSVC stack limit for compiler tools in "58c31ac5c8
Integrate LLVM to llvm/llvm-project@6be022066fd2 (#25045)" can be taken
out again here.

Assisted-by: Claude Code

Signed-off-by: Stefan Schuermans <schuermans@roofline.ai>
name: colab
